item.title: JUNNY to bring 'NULL' tour to Taipei, Singapore & Bangkok this March
item.description: JUNNY is heading back to Asia this March with a brand new tour and fresh music in tow. Presented by Flabbergast Productions, the [NULL] Asia Tour will take the Korean-Canadian R&B singer-songwriter to Taipei (22 March), Singapore (24 March), and Bangkok (26 March). This marks a new chapter for JUNNY as he gears up to perform his latest single, ‘SEASONS’, alongside fan-favourite hits in a live experience that's intimate, emotional, and immersive.
